title: General Site Visit Report
status: REVIEW ONLY. Source-derived definition and local preview. No live form, email draft, submission, or publication.
design_basis: Synthesis of recurring topics in nine original site-visit reports, September 8–October 6, 2026, as requested. Labels consolidate recurring topics; this is not a verbatim pre-existing form. Quoted daily logs and forwarded reports were excluded.
required_fields_policy: No required answers, fixed rating choices, mandatory owner, due date, or closure fields added.

report_metadata.label: Visit date
report_metadata.basis: Proposed organizational metadata replacing the email date context. Keep blank/editable: received date does not prove the date of the visit.

report_metadata.label: Visited by
report_metadata.basis: Source-derived: explicitly stated in the September 24 worksite report and otherwise identified by the report sender.

sites.basis: Francisco combines multiple site visits in one email, including October 1 and September 25, 22 and 14.

fields_in_order.label: Site visited
fields_in_order.source_basis: Job Site / Worksite / Site Location and subject naming.

fields_in_order.label: People on site
fields_in_order.help: Foreman, crew/count, and GC or other contacts met.
fields_in_order.source_basis: Personnel, On-site, Contacts, Foreman, Crew Size, and Personnel Met.

fields_in_order.label: Work and progress
fields_in_order.help: Areas visited, work completed or underway, and what was discussed.
fields_in_order.source_basis: Tasks Completed/In Progress, Status & Observations, Tasks & Scope, Current Scope & Operations, and Key Discussion Points & Site Progress.

fields_in_order.label: Issues and coordination
fields_in_order.help: Quality, safety, trade conflicts, access, materials or equipment, if any.
fields_in_order.source_basis: Consolidates report-specific Issues & Obstacles, Issues & Delays, quality/acceptance, Safety & Compliance, material orders and equipment/resource plans. These were not separate mandatory questions in Francisco's reports.

fields_in_order.label: Next steps and schedule
fields_in_order.help: Follow-up, work planned, or schedule changes, if any.
fields_in_order.source_basis: Next Steps & Scheduling, Status, Immediate Plan, Action Items, Upcoming Work & Projections, Schedule Update.

fields_in_order.label: Photos
fields_in_order.basis: Dan's explicit request for photos across the forms. Do not infer field-photo attachments from the presence of signature images or attachment flags.

proposed_implementation_only: Repeatable site block and Add another site control translate his multi-site email pattern into a form.
Photo attachment control is user requested. Actual upload, persistence and respondent access must be verified in the eventual hosted implementation.
Preview does not send or save data; selecting images only shows them locally in the page.
Visit date is an optional editable convenience field. No automatic claims about visit time.
If a live app supplies author or submission time automatically, disclose it visibly and do not present submission time as visit time.
